text:
This looks like leftover Greek-style yogurt: a small amount remains in the bowl, a little in the cup, and the plate holds only a lip balm tube and a few crumbs. The yogurt cup is probably a 150 g Farmers Union Greek Style pot, which has roughly 130 kcal per 100 g, since it is full-fat. The bowl seems to hold about 60 g of yogurt and the cup about 15 g. That gives roughly 75 g of food. At about 1.3 kcal/g, that comes to about 98 kcal. I'll round it to 100.

{"kcal": 100, "mass_g": 75}
